_note: Animated cats from the Pet Cats Pack (CC0, see CREDITS.md). One sheet per animation: frame_px square frames in a row, facing right, feet on row feet_px. Sheets live in art/cats/<cat>_<anim>.png (key cat.<cat>.<anim>), copied from the pack by tools/import_cats.gd. Each anim: file = the pack's sheet name; fps (time-driven) or stride_px (one frame per that many px walked); loops = times a one-shot plays (0 or missing = loops forever). The first anim is the cat's resting pose (its head marks where the paw prompt goes). fidgets: one-shots Fern plays after standing still fidget_after_s; npc.gd uses fidgets the same way for sitting cats. meow_vfx_s: how long the meow puff shows over a cat that starts speaking.
